coverage: 8 of 17 sources named in the research brief

mcp.note: not a runtime, local-first axis does not apply the same way - see research/protocols/mcp-2026-07-28.md

openai-agents-sdk.verdict: local-capable via explicit opt-in, not local-first by default

pydantic-ai.verdict: UNKNOWN - insufficient evidence, durable execution backends typically self-hostable

kimi-agent-sdk.verdict: UNKNOWN - genuinely unresolved after direct fetch

qwen-agent.verdict: strongest local-first signal so far - first-party vLLM/Ollama self-hosted model path

tencent-youtu-agent.verdict: CORRECTION to brief's framing: NOT confirmed local-first, cloud-configured by default

langgraph.verdict: HYBRID - genuine local single-process checkpointer path (SQLite) but production guidance requires PostgreSQL+Redis, and the server component (langgraph-api) is separately licensed

mastra.verdict: LOCAL_CAPABLE - strongest local-first storage story of the graph-based frameworks (LibSQL local file DB, no external infra); model-execution local-first status remains UNKNOWN

installment_3_observation: local-first is not one axis; LangGraph and Mastra are each strong on one dimension (checkpointing / storage) and unresolved on model execution - per-capability columns are load-bearing, not the single verdict
